overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by posting a vague agenda item for its November 4 meeting, ordered future compliance, and did not require the discussion to be re-held.

allegations.summary: A complainant alleged the November 4 notice item 'Preparation for Select Board Meeting' was too vague to show the committee would discuss a proposed new school on Bialek Park.
allegations.key_passage: We find, and the Committee has conceded, that this item was insufficiently specific.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Committee that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
